items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And he brought his trio and joined my clarinet and a tour in Japan.

ctx.x: That’s nice. So you never miss a gig, right? Can you think back, after World War II, there was probably a lot of American servicemen in Japan. Did they bring the music with them? Were they listening to jazz also?
Yes. Many Americans came to jazz clubs. And they enjoyed our playing jazz. And these people, an American musician came to Japan. Richard Wyands.
